created_prompt: I create online cooking videos for a follower base of 1.2 million viewers. I want to grow this number of followers even more over the next 3 years, and also am planning to publish a cookbook. Please create a 3-year concrete stepwise plan broken down, showing what I need to do over this period to achieve both of these goals. Note that I have only 4 days per week available to me for work, and also am on a limited budget. In terms of the cookbook aspect, create one plan for if I use traditional publishing and one plan for if I self-publish, since I haven't decided which yet.
